title: [ORG]AIOC-TOM - release notice to the next stage
description: Sent to the next stage on every filing of a decided TOM Release (blueprint §5.9 step 8a; Annex E.20; Protocol §19, item 5). It points to the filed release; it never carries release text, atom text or the name of a person. notice_id is 'TOMN-' + the SHA-256 of the canonical notice without notice_id. It is this AIOC's specialisation of the Library's release notice contract, proposed to 49GAION (library/contracts/release-notice.schema.json of 49GAION-protocol): the same fields, with this AIOC's patterns and values.

rests_on.description: The decided releases this release was designed from. A TOM Release rests on sources, never on another release, so the list is empty.

filed_ref.description: The filed copy of the release in Source Lifecycle, as the filing receipt names it.

final_status.description: Only a decided release is announced.

final_status_ref.description: The decision reference in Source Lifecycle.

answers.description: The returns this release answers (blueprint §5.10); may be empty.
